name: gen_nt_sq_sub_add_one_dvd_pow_sum
informal: Generalizes Mathlib2.nt_seven_dvd_pow_sum: the constants 3, 2, 7 → a, a−1, a²−a+1 for an arbitrary element a of an arbitrary commutative ring (a = 3 in ℤ gives the original). Proof idea: modulo a²−a+1 one has a² ≡ a−1 and (a−1)² ≡ −a, so a^(2n+1) ≡ a(a−1)^n and (a−1)^(n+2) ≡ −a(a−1)^n; formally induct on n with step a^(2n+3)+(a−1)^(n+3) = (a−1)(a^(2n+1)+(a−1)^(n+2)) + (a²−a+1)·a^(2n+1).
type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (a : R) (n : ℕ), a ^ 2 - a + 1 ∣ a ^ (2 * n + 1) + (a - 1) ^ (n + 2)
